research_question: can the thermogram identify its acquisition era among patients sharing a diagnosis
target: 1 = later acquisition era; the diagnosis is held constant within an arm
interpretation: above chance within_benign shows the encoder reads acquisition era from pixels, so the malignancy result is confounded; at chance it is evidence against a generic batch artifact. within_malignant is NOT attributable: no benign patient was acquired after 2015, so a protocol change and a change of case mix cannot be separated
